name: What type of drywall is required for bathrooms and wet areas?

mainEntity.name: What type of drywall is required for bathrooms and wet areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moisture and mold resistance is essential in bathrooms, laundry rooms, basements, and behind plumbing fixtures. In standard bathroom areas with high humidity, moisture-resistant drywall, commonly known as green board, prevents dampness from weakening the gypsum core. For high-splash areas, tub surrounds, and tile showers, standard drywall or green board is inadequate; cement backer boards or waterproof membrane panels are required to create a stable substrate that will not deteriorate behind grout. When remodeling bathrooms, matching the board type to direct water exposure prevents rot and failed tile later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moisture-resistant green board is standard for bathroom walls, while cement backer board is required inside showers and behind tiled wet areas.
